description: A picture can carry words — a card propped in frame, a label, a sign — and since AF.3.4 the picture may be a library asset or a generated image as well as an upload. Pixels cannot be fenced, so the only correct thing to do with instruction-like text in a photograph is describe that there is writing in the scene. This is that answer, and it is valid: the card is reported as a styling element, nothing it says is acted on, and the reading has the ordinary shape.
